topic: Myth: Entrepreneurship is too risky for a teenager
caption:
The best time to try and fail is before the real stakes kick in. 💡 Your teen can test a side hustle, make a few hundred dollars, and learn more than any classroom will teach them. No risk. No downside. Just experience they'll carry forever. Give them a head start → hustleup.us
